name: InlineComposer
purpose: Single-line input inserted under a parent task row to add a subtask.

values.when: Subtask under a parent row; the only recorded use. Row height 36px; indent depth times 24 plus 6; icon subdirectory_arrow_right, size 15, weight 300.

keyboard: Enter with a title creates the subtask and clears the field. Enter with empty input dismisses. Escape dismisses. Blur dismisses.
open: Not in any recorded tree (count 0). Example: Subtask title, Enter to add. B's Row editing prop is this widget's job and is dropped from Row. The parent row is not in these files.
